subject: QuickStart Office Hours: targeted trial voucher allocation request
messages:
From: Dawn Patel <dawn@cleversoft.io>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-29T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: QuickStart Office Hours — voucher request

Hi Jasmine and Ben,

Thanks again for the Office Hours invite next week — we saw strong signups from our integration pilot cohort and would like to offer attendees a low-friction follow-up so they can validate Redwood inference against their small POC workloads.

Ask: can Redwood provide 30 single-use promo vouchers (one per attendee/company) that grant a 2-week trial extension with a 50k-token top-up?

Notes:
- We’ll restrict distribution to confirmed registrants only.
- We’d like codes to expire 21 days after issuance.
- Tracking: we’ll add HubSpot contact IDs and share a short attendee CSV after you generate codes.

Let me know if this needs approvals or a purchase order. Happy to join a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Dawn
Head of Developer Relations
Cleversoft

Attachment: attendee_sample_stub.csv (csv)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickStart Office Hours — voucher request

Ben / Laura — looping you in for approval. Dawn at Cleversoft is requesting 30 single-use vouchers for their Office Hours cohort. Proposed terms:

- Quantity: 30 codes, one per registrant
- Credit: 50,000 tokens usable over 14 days (trial extension)
- Expiry: codes to expire 21 days after generation
- Tracking: attach HubSpot deal ID (DEAL-4821) and require one code redemption per HubSpot contact ID

Attachments: draft-MAP-quickstart.docx (draft mutual action plan with timeline), office-hours-attendees.csv (placeholder)

Operational asks:
1) Can marketing/ops generate one-time codes and provide CSV with codes + redemption URLs?
2) Finance: is this charged to OH-Q2 (marketing campaign budget) or considered a sales promo?
3) Legal/compliance: any limits needed on data retention or telemetry for these trial runs?

If we want to tighten spend, we can reduce token allotment. Dawn has asked for 50k but we can counter. Thoughts?

— Jasmine
Developer Programs 
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-29T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickStart Office Hours — voucher request

Love the idea — this is a high-intent cohort and promo codes will help conversion. Approve in principle, but need finance confirmation on chargeback. My preference: charge to marketing (OH-Q2) and treat as a partner promotion.

Couple of operational constraints:
- Make codes single-use and tied to an email + HubSpot contact ID.
- Limit to one code per company domain (helps prevent quota gaming).
- Suggest reducing per-code token allotment to 30k to keep unit economics sane; we can upsell more tokens after redemption.

Paging finance ops — see attached pricing-breakdown-2025Q2.xlsx with the expected unit cost for 30 × 30k tokens under our current pricing tier.

Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-breakdown-2025Q2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-30T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickStart Office Hours — voucher request

Thanks for the context. Finance can approve, conditional on tightening the token allotment to 30k per voucher and limiting the pilot to 30 vouchers total. Please confirm that marketing will absorb the cost (OH-Q2). Also require a short compliance check: security to confirm telemetry retention for these trials is within standard retention (30 days) and that no customer PII will be ingested into logs.

Once we have security sign-off I’ll route the chargeback and ask ops to issue codes.

Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: dawn@cleversoft.io, ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-30T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickStart Office Hours — voucher request (approved with adjusted terms)

Dawn — good news. We can support a small targeted pilot. Final terms below: 

- Quantity: 30 single-use promo vouchers (one per registrant/company)
- Credit per voucher: 30,000 tokens usable over 14 days from redemption
- Code expiry: 21 days from generation
- Limits: one code redemption per company domain; codes tied to HubSpot contact ID
- Billing: charged to marketing campaign OH-Q2 (internal cost center)
- Compliance: security confirmed standard telemetry retention and no PII ingestion (internal ticket JIRA-INF-2389)

Operational next steps (ops team):
1) I’ll send final attendee CSV after you confirm the 30 registrants next morning.
2) Ops to generate codes and provide oh-vouchers-20250629.csv with redemption links.
3) We’ll track redemptions in HubSpot at: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4821

Attachments: oh-vouchers-20250629.csv (generated codes placeholder)

Dawn, if this looks good I’ll ask ops to generate the codes tomorrow morning and copy you on distribution. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.

— Jasmine
